name: The Abandoned Keep
summary: Himo Xiloscient's ward-keep in the broken hills west of Adlmyr, empty since Adlmyr fell. The wards are failing, Haggoth's gnolls have found the gatehouse, and the Kingswood branch of the Ley runs under the cellars.

levels.name: The walls and yard
levels.summary: Open to the sky where the roofs have gone.

levels.name: The keep
levels.summary: The tower block, cold and mostly dry.

levels.name: Under the keep
levels.summary: Cellars cut into the rock, and older stone below them.

rooms.name: The broken gate
rooms.summary: The gate leaf lies flat in the grass where something pulled it off its pins. Crows on the wall walk.
features: claw marks on the gate posts

rooms.name: The gatehouse
rooms.summary: A low guardroom that stinks of wet fur and old meat. Someone has been sleeping here, in a nest of rotten blankets.
features: a nest of blankets and bones
a murder hole over the gate passage

rooms.name: The ward-stone court
rooms.summary: A ring of standing stones in the yard, cut with Xiloscient's wards. Most of the lines have worn smooth. Two stones have been toppled on purpose, recently.
features: two stones pulled down with ropes
rooms.lore: The wards were cut to hold the place where the horde came through. A character who knows the Ley can feel the current under the yard, weak and uneven, like a pulse in a sick man.

rooms.name: The old barracks
rooms.summary: Long and roofless, rows of rotted bunks under the sky. Elves and Cyrel soldiers both carved their names into the same beams.
features: a soldier's chest under the rubble

rooms.name: The cold hall
rooms.summary: The keep's great hall, colder than the night outside. Frost on the inside of the walls in high summer. The long table is still set for a meal no one came back to.
features: a hearth that will not stay lit

hazard.action: keep a fire or lamp burning in the cold hall
hazard.threat: The flame shrinks to a blue bead and goes out. In the dark the cold gets into the chest, and every breath hurts.

rooms.name: The commander's room
rooms.summary: A narrow room at the top of the stair, with a window over the broken hills toward Adlmyr. The last garrison commander's log is still on the desk.
rooms.lore: The log's last entries count the fall of Adlmyr in smoke on the horizon, then orders to march, then nothing. On the last page, in another hand: the stones will not hold without someone to feed them.

rooms.name: The cellars
rooms.summary: Storerooms cut into the rock under the keep. Broken barrels, a smell of old wine, and rats that do not run from a light.

rooms.name: The Ley vault
rooms.summary: A round chamber of older stone than the keep, cut before the keep was built. The Kingswood branch of the Ley runs through it as a seam of faint light in the floor, and the floor is warm.
features: the seam of light in the floor
a circle of ward cuts around it

hazard.action: touch the seam without being taken by it

threat.text: The current takes hold through the hands and does not let go. Something on the other side of it notices.

rooms.lore: This is what the keep was built to guard. The ward cuts here are fresher than the ones in the yard: someone has been keeping them, and has stopped.

passages.summary: a low door in the gate passage
a spiral stair in the wall
a cistern wall that is a door

trap.action: open the cistern door without loosing the ward on it
trap.threat: A ward-cut flares as the stone moves and burns a line of white pain up the arm.

wanders.text: Wind through the broken roofs, carrying the smell of a cookfire from the hills.
Crows go up off the wall all at once, and then nothing happens.

wanders.action: hear the gnolls coming back before they reach the gate

threat.text: Gnolls come in through the broken gate, laughing their high laugh, spears up.

wanders.action: keep away from where the wards have failed

threat.text: Something long dead and badly buried pulls itself up out of the yard where a stone has fallen.
